articles.title: Liquid AI Releases LiquidCodec, a 74M-Parameter Streaming Audio Codec
articles.excerpt: Liquid AI released LiquidCodec, a ~74M-parameter streaming audio codec that powers LFM3-Audio-2B and LFM3-Omni-2B. 5 Hz with 12 codebooks and encodes about 361x faster than real time on a single CPU thread

articles.title: IBM Announces IBM Quantum Nighthawk r3: A New Processor to Support 10k Quantum Operations on 520 Programmable Qubits
articles.excerpt: IBM announced Quantum Nighthawk r3, a 520-qubit processor designed for 10,000 quantum operations.  2 r3 chips will link into a 1,040-qubit system in 2027, while Nighthawk r2 already posts up to 19x speedups over Heron
